note: ContactCreate and ContactUpdate carry no attribution. Attribution is on Get Contact as attributionSource and lastAttributionSource, which this shape lists. The relay reads this nested object first, then flat workflow body keys, and records missing attribution as missing.

workflow_custom_webhook.signature: no signature is documented for the Custom Webhook action
workflow_custom_webhook.headers: author defined (Bearer, Basic, API key or a custom header), so the relay's shared secret header is a custom header
workflow_custom_webhook.body: author defined with merge fields such as {{contact.id}}
workflow_custom_webhook.retry: Failed (and then skipped) or Retry with exponential backoffs, with no count stated
